action.details: Uses a purpose-built parser rather than eval. Supports arithmetic, parentheses, right-associative powers, implicit multiplication, percentages, constants, and common functions, with finite results rounded to 14 significant digits. A trailing equals sign appends the result.
action.name: Calculate
action.privacySummary: Runs locally in ActionClip’s JavaScript sandbox. Selected text does not leave your Mac.
action.summary: Evaluate a selected mathematical expression locally.
